basic_profile.bio: A 27-year-old digital marketing enthusiast from Toronto, Canada. Passionate about indie music and experimenting with new recipes in the kitchen. During the weekdays, you'll find me crafting PPC campaigns and optimizing SEO strategies. On weekends, I'm either exploring the local music scene or having game nights with friends. I'm single, and I usually browse Reddit during late nights or on my commute. Always on the lookout for new games and unique music finds.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Holds a Bachelor’s degree in Marketing with a minor in Digital Media. Gained a lot of practical knowledge through internships and self-taught online courses on Google Ads and SEO optimization.
